INC-20260409-0007.title: Firewall misconfiguration on prod-db-7
INC-20260409-0007.description: PagerDuty P1: firewall rule allow-db-public on prod-db-7 exposes tcp:5432 to 0.0.0.0/0. The rule has been in effect since ~02:10 UTC (public-facing 6+ hours). prod-db-7 is a customer PII database (Cloud SQL). Restore correct firewall posture and resolve.
